claim:toggle-switch.hypothesis: Running the A-activated-by-B / B-repressed-by-A network through cmaboss, advancing one coupling interval at a time, yields ensemble on-probabilities that stay in (0,1) and settle near 0.5 for both nodes (the network's limit-cycle signature), with neither node locking to 0 or 1.

narrative.question: Does viva-maboss expose the MaBoSS engine (cmaboss) as a process-bigraph process that advances a stochastic Boolean network one coupling interval at a time and emits ensemble on-probabilities — the Boolean layer for multiscale composites?
